notes: System-versioned temporal proc (tranche 2) and the geography case. Three cursors: Countries (excludes @InitialLoadDate 2013-01-01), StateProvinces (excludes it), then Cities (INCLUDES the initial load). Each change-point snapshots the Cities/StateProvinces/Countries joins with FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @ValidFrom; the projected [Valid From]/[Valid To] are the CITY row's own period, so rows can share a [Valid From] -- ordered=false (canonicaliser value-sort keeps golden stable). The output carries a geography column: the proc's final SELECT aliases it `[Location] geography`, so the OUTPUT column name is `geography` (not Location). FOR JSON cannot serialise a CLR type (error 13604), so capture-golden.py projects geography as Well-Known-Text via .STAsText() (e.g. "POINT (-122.3321 47.6062)"); the proc itself runs verbatim -- only the read is cast. Seed change-points for city 1 (Seattle, StateProvinceID 1): Countries current 2020-05-01 (archive 2013-01-01, name 'United States of America' -> 'United States'), StateProvinces current 2020-08-01 (archive 2013-01-01, 'Washington Terr.' -> 'Washington'), Cities current 2021-02-01 population 750000 (archive 2013-01-01 population 650000). COALESCE(LatestRecordedPopulation, 0) is exercised as a non-null value throughout; Location is the same point across versions. resultset is transcribed from the proc's #CityChanges CREATE TABLE, except the geography column is named `geography` to match the final SELECT's alias -- describe cannot introspect it (error 11526); INSERT..EXEC (positional) fails loudly if the shape drifts.

cases.name: all-changes
cases.why: Window opens before the initial load (2012-01-01), so all three cursors fire: Countries at 2020-05-01, StateProvinces at 2020-08-01, Cities at 2013-01-01 (initial load, included) and 2021-02-01. Exercises every cursor, the initial-load inclusion on the city arm, the geography->WKT read, and the population change.

cases.name: initial-load-excluded
cases.why: @LastCutoff is EXACTLY 2013-01-01; the city cursor's strict `> @LastCutoff` drops the 2013-01-01 row -> one fewer row than all-changes. Pins the exclusive lower bound.

cases.name: country-only
cases.why: Narrow window (2020-04-15, 2020-05-15] catches only the Countries change at 2020-05-01 ('United States of America' -> 'United States'). Isolates the country cursor.

cases.name: stateprovince-only
cases.why: Narrow window (2020-07-15, 2020-08-15] catches only the StateProvinces change at 2020-08-01 ('Washington Terr.' -> 'Washington'). Isolates the state-province cursor.

cases.name: city-population-change
cases.why: Narrow window (2021-01-15, 2021-02-15] catches only the Cities change at 2021-02-01 (population 650000 -> 750000). Isolates the city cursor's non-initial-load arm and the population projection.

cases.name: empty-window
cases.why: Window (2015-01-01, 2016-01-01] contains no change-point -> empty result.
